description: No codemix or abbreviate matches in this text (n_substitutions=0), so it isolates transliteration's mixed-script mode + misspell's Channel B/A, which must still fire correctly in their (unchanged) position at the end of the fixed order. At heavy severity only ~40% of words get romanized at all (see transliteration.py's mixed_script_rate) -- most of this short text stays in native Sinhala script, and expect_substring pins one specific Channel B typo ('kheya', a vowel-length mutation of a transliterated word) surviving into the final compound output.
text: ඔය බනින්නෙ.. හරකා, මී හරකා කිය කිය...
